app.name: Rail Builder
app.description: Add your wooden railway sets: the app invents the layouts you can build, bridges and switches included, and guides your child step by step.

home.title: No more <hl>same old oval</hl> every Sunday.
home.subtitle: Add your sets, mix them: the app invents the layouts you can build right now, with bridges, switches and tunnels, then guides your child step by step.
home.showcaseText: The engine combines the pieces of your sets and checks every layout: everything fits together and the loop closes.
home.step1Text: Pick your boxes from the catalogue, or take a photo of yours. The pieces add up on their own.
home.step2Text: Choose the size and what you want: a bridge, a switch, a crossing, scenery. The app invents the layouts.
home.step3Text: Your child follows the plan step by step, then taps “I built it!”.
home.kidText: Put a tablet on the floor next to the track, and off you go.
home.kidPoint1: One piece at a time, highlighted on the plan
home.kidPoint4: No ads, no purchases, no external links

pieces.title: Piece catalogue
pieces.intro: Each piece is described by its shape and its ends (peg or hole): that is how the engine checks that a layout closes. Compatible track dimensions: 54, 108, 144 and 216 mm straights, 202 and 110 mm radius curves.
